mentions.note: Pipeline and infrastructure play not levered to commodity prices; preferred for energy exposure vs. upstream producers.
Preferred over Cheniere for better growth and yield.
Preferred midstream/LNG transport play. Strong structural exposure to energy infrastructure.

Pipeline operator positioned for LNG growth to 30 BCF by 2030 (+12 BCF/day); Bakken has 5,000 wells to drill; expected crude exports 14–15M barrels/day (vs. prior 3.5M); strong capital allocation (dividends, debt paydown, buybacks); 4.85% yield.
Named alongside Enbridge as a dividend payer with growth characteristics, better suited than plain Treasury paper for long-term investors.
